create.name: Anjie Cho
create.bio:
Anjie Cho is a New York teacher of feng shui, ikebana and dharma art, and a licensed architect who has been designing homes and workplaces since 1999. She approaches space as both inner and outer, drawing on Black Sect (BTB) feng shui, in which she trained and certified with mentors Katherine Metz and Rosalie Prinzivalli, and on Buddhist practice, quoting Chögyam Trungpa on dharma art. Since 2015 she has studied ikebana, Japanese flower arranging, in the Ikenobo school, where she now holds a teaching rank and sits on the New York chapter board.

With Laura Morris she co-founded the Mindful Design Feng Shui School, which runs a live online certification taught over six months, and the pair co-host the Holistic Spaces podcast. Anjie teaches ikebana as a contemplative practice that opens with guided meditation and treats arranging flowers as meditation in motion, in workshops and retreats in New York and further afield, and she gives one-to-one feng shui consultations online or in person. Her books are Holistic Spaces and Mindful Homes, and she co-wrote Mindful Living. She studied architecture at the University of California, Berkeley.

courses.title: Mindful Ikebana at the Isamu Noguchi Foundation and Garden Museum
courses.description: A morning session in the Noguchi Museum galleries in Long Island City that begins with guided meditation and conversation, then moves into making simple seasonal flower arrangements as a moving meditation. No experience needed; materials and museum entry are included.

courses.title: One-to-One Feng Shui Session with Anjie Cho
courses.description: A personal feng shui consultation with Anjie, online or, case by case, in person, looking at how a home or workspace can better support the life you want. Booked by email.

courses.title: Mindful Design Feng Shui Certification Program
courses.description: A 100-hour live online certification taught by Anjie and Laura Morris once a year from February to July, opening with an intensive weekend and continuing with weekly classes, case studies and observed client consultations.

free_resources.title: Holistic Spaces Podcast
free_resources.description: Anjie and Laura Morris's free podcast on feng shui, mindful living and creating supportive spaces at home and at work.
